title: Molecular design and performance of emissive amide-containing compounds as corrosion inhibitors: synthesis, electrochemical evaluation, DFT calculations and molecular dynamics simulations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15384-15396
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00978B, Paper
Open Access

Abdelreheem A. Saddik, Mostafa Sayed, Ahmed A. K. Mohammed, Mohamed Abdel-Hakim, Mostafa Ahmed
This study investigates the corrosion inhibition of mild steel in 1.0 M H2SO4 using our developed amide-containing compounds which contain naphthalene or benzene moiety, theoretical calculations were performed to support the results.
